Multi-Criteria Site Selection for a Biathlon High School

The challenge

Local policymakers in the Joensuu area needed to identify the optimal site for a new biathlon-oriented high school. Four competing spatial criteria had to be balanced: maximise distance from existing schools, minimise distance to training facilities, maximise youth population within 3 km, and avoid sites within 100 m of inland waters.

The approach

Each criterion was converted into a spatial layer and reclassified into comparable score ranges. Weights were assigned based on policymaker priorities. ArcGIS Pro Model Builder was used to build a documented, repeatable workflow applying Cost Surface, Cost Distance, and weighted overlay — producing a final suitability surface from which candidate sites were extracted and ranked.

Key outcomes

Optimal school site identified through multi-criteria weighted spatial analysis

Full workflow built and documented in Model Builder for reproducibility

Four competing planning criteria balanced into a single suitability index
